gloss: cash voucher; gift certificate; monetary ticket

definitions.gloss: cash voucher; gift certificate; monetary ticket
definitions.explanation: A ticket or voucher with monetary value that can be used in place of cash. Includes gift cards, department store vouchers, beer tickets, and other prepaid instruments.

examples.japanese: {金券|きんけん}⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy tickets at a discount ticket shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{商品券|しょうひんけん}→商品券：22121_shouhinken⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金券|きんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Gift certificates and other cash vouchers are sometimes given as celebratory gifts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金券|きんけん}⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: At the discount ticket shop in front of the station, you can get Shinkansen tickets cheaper than the regular price.

notes:
Composed of {金|きん} (money, gold) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket, voucher). A general term for any voucher, ticket, or certificate that has monetary value and can be exchanged for goods or services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金券|きんけん}⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧ (discount ticket shop)
- {金券|きんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧ (to give a cash voucher as a gift)
- {金券|きんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{換金|かんきん}→換金：28179_kankin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to convert a voucher to cash)
- {金券|きんけん}⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (cash vouchers and the like)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{商品券|しょうひんけん}→商品券：22121_shouhinken⟧ — gift certificate; specifically for purchasing merchandise at a particular store or chain
- {図書券|としょけん} — book voucher; specifically for buying books (now replaced by ⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧)
- ⟦{回数券|かいすうけん}→回数券：08451_kaisuuken⟧ — multi-ride ticket; a book of tickets for repeated use

CULTURAL NOTE:
{金券|きんけん}⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧ (discount ticket shops) are a distinctive feature of Japanese cities, especially near train stations. They buy and sell various vouchers, train tickets, stamps, and gift certificates at a small discount. Travelers often use them to save money on ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧ tickets and other transportation.
